name: Geodynamics
summary: Quantitative physics of the solid Earth: heat, flexure, flow and convection that drive plate tectonics.

topics.name: Stress and strain in the lithosphere; elasticity
Flexure of the lithosphere: plates, basins and seamounts
Heat transfer: conduction, cooling of oceanic lithosphere and heat flow
Gravity, geoid anomalies and isostatic compensation
Fluid mechanics of the mantle: viscous flow, Stokes flow and postglacial rebound
Mantle convection: Rayleigh number, boundary layers and plumes
Rock rheology and faulting mechanics (friction and rate-and-state laws)
Flow in porous media and magma migration
